fields.label: Identity / senses
fields.value: A public archive suspended beneath the bell tower. Dust smells of warm brass; file drawers click one second before they open.

fields.label: Useful features
fields.value: A rotating index ladder reaches sealed upper drawers. A speaking tube carries requests to the night clerk. The glass floor reveals the collection pipes below.

fields.label: Face / current pressure
fields.value: Retired clerk Pell keeps the index. An Office order will transfer the closing-time records to Vale's private vault at midnight.

fields.label: Danger / warning
fields.value: A red safety shutter trembles before the indexing counterweight moves. Crossing the ladder's travel path when the bell sounds can pin a visitor; stop the wheel or use the maintenance ledge.

fields.label: Opportunity
fields.value: The carbon-copy index lists the warrant receipt hidden by Nera. It can also reveal the legal route to suspend a collection.

fields.label: GM secret / discovery
fields.value: A duplicate roll predates its official authorization. Compare receipt times, inspect the paper with Ledgerglass, or ask Pell about the after-hours countersignature.

fields.label: Mechanics boundary
fields.value: No automatic skills, stress or consequence slots. Add temporary situation aspects only when framing an active scene.
